obligations.description: 中国LLM / foundation modelの前史から現在までを、主要model familyの一次資料に基づくchronologyとして再構成し、後知恵による系譜の捏造を避ける。
obligations.rationale: The major Chinese foundation-model lineages are reconstructed with primary sources from early seeds through 2026 endpoints, but Kimi's October 2023 launch remains supported only by a secondary investor account and must stay source-qualified.

obligations.description: DeepSeek、Qwen、GLM、Kimiを個別のorganization / model familyとして扱い、architecture、公開戦略、用途、ecosystem上の差異を維持する。
obligations.rationale: DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM and Kimi are retained as distinct families with version-specific architecture, release and strategy evidence; MiniMax, Yi and Baichuan are separately classified as competing/bridge/context branches.

obligations.description: reasoning、coding、long context、agentic capabilityへの展開を、model versionと評価条件を混同せずに追跡する。
obligations.rationale: Reasoning, coding, long-context, multimodal and agentic evolution is traced through version-specific primary papers/model cards without merging model versions or incompatible evaluations.

obligations.description: training / inference efficiency、MoE等のarchitecture、serving / inference stack、local deploymentが競争力へどう寄与したかを検証する。
obligations.rationale: MLA/DeepSeekMoE, GLM sparse-attention mechanisms, Qwen architecture/deployment, Kimi long-context/MoE work and official serving paths provide source-bound evidence for efficiency and serving; X runtime claims remain excluded.

obligations.description: cloud、API、Hugging Face等のdistribution、tooling、fine-tuning、local inference、国際的developer adoptionを含むecosystem形成を検証する。
obligations.rationale: Official repositories, model cards and reports establish distribution, local/serving paths and family-platform strategies sufficiently for the architecture; community runtime prevalence is not generalized from X.

obligations.description: Open SourceとOpen Weightを区別し、weights、code、training recipe、license、redistribution、commercial use、reproducibilityの各境界をmodel familyごとに確認する。
obligations.rationale: The corpus preserves artifact-specific differences among model weights, repository code and commercial conditions, including Apache-2.0, MIT, historical ChatGLM permissions and the exact Kimi K3 License.

obligations.description: closed frontier modelとの競争を評価条件の差を明示して扱い、policy / geopoliticsは技術史上の因果説明に必要な範囲へ限定する。
obligations.rationale: Competition is treated through source-specific family transitions and explicit evaluation boundaries; enterprise China-origin restrictions and broad market prevalence remain uncorroborated community signals rather than technical facts.

residual_limitations: Kimi's October 2023 launch/context-window chronology remains secondary-source qualified until a stronger first-party archival source is added.
X runtime-adoption, license-friction and enterprise-origin-policy observations remain HOLD and cannot support performance, legal or prevalence claims.
Cross-family benchmark ranking is intentionally excluded where model versions, benchmark conditions or evaluation methods are incompatible.
